description:
Recommendation: preserve the current baseline and make release readiness explicit before broader connector expansion.

Scope:
- Add or update a release-readiness checklist for the umbrella and individual provider packages.
- Include current verification commands for root packages and dev/demo.
- Note that the repository should be pushed before beginning the next large connector wave.
- Do not implement Hex publishing automation in this issue; keep it as guidance/checklist only.

Primary files:
- README.md
- CHANGELOG.md or RELEASE.md if present/appropriate
- package docs for apps/jido_connect, apps/jido_connect_github, apps/jido_connect_slack, apps/jido_connect_mcp if needed

Acceptance:
- There is a clear baseline checklist for future release prep.
- Hex publishing details are not overbuilt yet.
- The current ahead-of-origin state is called out as an operator action, not hidden in code.
title: Add release baseline and verification checklist
